title: StSport
subtitle: Integrated Sports Facility Booking & Equipment Management System
description:
StSport is an integrated sports management platform that simplifies **sports facility reservations** and **sports equipment purchases** through one centralized mobile application.

## Project type

Information Systems Analysis & Design · System Architecture · UI/UX Design · Business Intelligence — Academic Project, BINUS University, 2025–2026.

## Overview

Customers can explore sports categories, discover available facilities, schedule court reservations, and pay through Virtual Accounts. A dedicated marketplace for sport-specific equipment means facility bookings and essential gear live in one ecosystem.

Beyond the customer side, StSport includes partner-side booking confirmation and administrative management. Partner staff review reservations and verify schedule availability, while administrators monitor monthly booking performance and quarterly equipment sales through analytical dashboards — revenue trends, sports distribution, and top-selling products.

## Key system capabilities

- **Sports facility booking:** browse sports categories, explore facilities, check availability, and reserve time slots.
- **Virtual Account payments:** booking payments with automatic cancellation for reservations left unpaid past the payment window.
- **Sports equipment purchasing:** browse and buy sport-specific equipment through an integrated ordering system.
- **Booking management:** review reservations, submit cancellations, and process refund workflows.
- **Partner management:** facility partners verify reservations, confirm schedules, and prevent booking conflicts.
- **Business intelligence dashboard:** monthly booking reports, quarterly equipment sales analysis, revenue trends, and top-five product rankings.

## System design & architecture

The project follows a structured System Analysis and Design approach — Fishbone Diagrams, Data Flow Diagrams, Use Case Models, Class Diagrams, Sequence Diagrams, State Transition Diagrams, and Activity Diagrams.

The system adopts a **three-tier Client/Server architecture**, separating the mobile interface, the application processing layer, and the database layer to support modular operations and centralized transaction handling.

## Objective

To build an integrated sports service ecosystem that streamlines facility reservations, simplifies equipment purchasing, improves partner coordination, and gives administrators the insight they need for operational decisions.
